svg.text: Radial Pulse database — 27 tables, keys and relationships
After migration 0011 · every table has a primary key · links inside one clinic use two-column foreign keys
users M : N clinics (through the link tables)
1 : N every table below has clinic_id — each row belongs to ONE clinic
foreign key: points at another table
UNIQUE (a, b) = these columns TOGETHER never repeat (composite key)
FK (a, b) → t = two-column link: the parent must be in the SAME clinic
1 / N / 0..1 at the line ends = how many rows on each side
1 : 1 one to one · 1 : N one to many · M : N many to many (link table)
Every table also has created_at / updated_at. *_by_user_id columns
(who did it) point at users; those lines are not drawn.
